lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters; specifically, a prominent vertical alignment of five spots is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, followed by a regular grid-like distribution toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank; the dorsal-most ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity reflection on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density; approximately 7 to 9 high-luminance spots are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, predominantly clustered in the lower half and along the anterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) clustered on the ventral-lateral surface and the proximal dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
